depictions.name: Artemision
depictions.text: The Artemision was a Spartan war trireme once commanded by Eurybiades during the Battle of Artemisium. More than 50 years after the Greco-Persian Wars, the Artemision remained active and was once used by the Spartans during the Peloponnesian War. Between 429 and 422 BCE, the misthios Kassandra received a bounty placed on the Artemision.
